summary: Re-tested all 6 LUNAVIA manual-lunar-landing bugs after iteration-2 fix was applied. All 6 core bugs are now RESOLVED. Verified via 3 full Manual Descent runs on CADET difficulty against the live preview URL.

issues: When a landing 'crashes' but landing-accuracy label is POOR (distance 20-40 m), the accuracy row shows the green 'SAFE' chip. This is intentional per code (safe={label!=='MISS'}) but can look inconsistent next to 'MISSION FAILED · CREW LOST' — consider showing SAFE only when label is ACCEPTABLE/GOOD/EXCELLENT.

critical_code_review_comments: gradeLanding() cap `total = crashed ? Math.min(rawTotal, 25) : rawTotal` may cause total to DISAGREE with the visible chip sum when raw>25 in a crash (chips would add to >25 but total shows 25). In all three observed crashes the raw was below 25 so the discrepancy did not trigger, but is a latent bug — either always show raw sum or cap the chips too.

In DescentGame.jsx line 613 `setTimeout(() => onCrash && onCrash(result), 2200)` delivers the crash callback 2.2s after MissionResult is already displayed; state transition to STATES.RESULT is fine because the outcome is already committed and endedRef locks input, but the delayed callback pattern is fragile if a user navigates during the timeout.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live URL https://lunar-journey-3.preview.emergentagent.com/mission. Automated Playwright cannot reliably achieve a soft-landing in CADET (crash 3 in a row) — Bug 5 S/A/B/C/D grade on success and REGRESSION continue→complete-overlay flow could not be verified via automation but are code-verified (Mission.jsx handleContinueFromResult early-returns on crash, MissionResult only renders result-continue when !isCrash, gradeLanding assigns F only when failureReasons.length>0). Consider manual smoke on the success path.

bug1_hard_landing_termination.evidence: Free-fall on CADET → mission-result appears with title 'HARD LANDING', grade 'F', failure-reasons visible listing 'VERTICAL SPEED EXCEEDED SAFE LIMIT', result-continue does NOT exist, result-end-mission present. Clicking result-end-mission returns to CONTROL (control-room visible).

bug2_lm_locked_after_result.evidence: After mission-result shown, pressing Space/A/D leaves gauge-altitude=0 and gauge-vspeed=0, throttle 0%, result overlay still visible.

bug3_abort_modal_pauses_physics.evidence: Opened abort at alt=312m. 4-second wait: alt stayed 312m, vspeed stayed -28.3 m/s (identical). After abort-cancel physics resumed (alt dropped to 276m within 1.5s).

bug4_landing_accuracy_dynamic.evidence: Three attempts produced distinct distances (~44m free-fall, 624m throttle-only, 35.3m controlled) with matching labels — accuracy is not fixed.

bug5_score_formula_40_30_20_10.evidence: Chips per row show +X/40 (row-vy), +X/30 (row-accuracy), +X/20 (row-tilt), +X/10 (row-fuel). Chip sums match result-total-score in all three runs (e.g. 0+12+0+0 = 12 total). Grade F awarded correctly on all crashes. S/A/B/C/D on success is code-verified.

bug6_result_explains_metrics.evidence: All six rows (row-vy, row-vx, row-accuracy, row-tilt, row-fuel, row-crew) present. Numeric value + SAFE/UNSAFE badge on each. On crash: row-vy and row-crew both display UNSAFE as required.
